import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r'\b(TMP|a|b)\s*<-\s*'
    r'(?:\(\s*(TMP|a|b)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+)|(\d+))'
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    target, source, amount, modulus, literal = match.groups()
    if literal is not None:
        values[target] = int(literal)
    else:
        values[target] = (values[source] + int(amount)) % int(modulus)

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
